description: Core + event permissions for the HUD main window. The frontend listens for five Rust-emitted events (hud:mode — which of the three interaction modes is live, hud:authed, hud:config, hud:context, hud:context-stale — the last two carry the live-op push from the member socket); app-defined commands (login/get_config/set_config/set_mode/…) stay allowlist-free as local app commands.
